title: prismatomeris tetrandra subsp. multiflora
intro: Prismatomeris tetrandra subsp. multiflora, commonly known as a medicinal plant species, is a type of flowering plant in the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Prismatomeris tetrandra subsp. multiflora include wound healing, antidiabetic, and anti-cancer activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Prismatomeris tetrandra subsp. multiflora have been shown to have potential therapeutic applications in treating various diseases, making it a valuable plant resource for traditional medicine.
